analysis.problem_type: Learn the operator that maps initial conditions to the full spatio-temporal solution field.
analysis.description: The code implements a QR-DeepONet to learn the solution operator for the Burgers equation using a two-stage training process and variational Residual-Based Attention (vRBA) for adaptive loss weighting.

analysis.problem_type: Learn the operator that maps initial conditions to the full spatio-temporal solution field for the Burgers equation.
analysis.description: A DeepONet implementation using JAX/Flax to learn the solution operator of the Burgers equation, featuring a variational Residual-Based Attention (vRBA) mechanism for adaptive loss weighting and importance sampling.
